query: SELECT cl.id, cl.slug, cl.title, cl.order_index, cl.estimated_minutes, LENGTH(cl.content) as content_length, LEFT(cl.content, 200) as content_preview FROM course_lessons cl JOIN course_modules cm ON cl.module_id = cm.id WHERE cm.slug = 'fluid-power' ORDER BY cl.order_index;
